entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I want to return something. This is completely unacceptable. I'm looking at this jersey I bought and it's a total joke.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
A preference? No! It's the wrong size! Your sizing chart is a lie. This thing is way too tight, I can barely get it on. I need to send it back immediately.
Okay, I understand. It sounds like a sizing issue then. I can definitely help you with that. Would you be looking for a refund, or would you like to exchange it for a larger size?

Don't 'look into it,' just do it! This is ridiculous! I paid good money and I can't even wear it. If you don't fix this right now, I'm writing reviews on every single website I can find. Get me your manager!

I understand your frustration, sir, and I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. Let me just confirm your order details. I see you purchased the Aero-Flow jersey and it was delivered five days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. Now what are you going to do about it?

Well, the good news is you're well within our return window. For a standard item like a jersey, you have 90 days to make a return. I can process that for you right now and get a return label sent to your email.
Oh. Ninety days? Well... fine. Just process the refund. I don't want an exchange anymore. I'll buy somewhere else.

Of course. I have just initiated the full refund process. A pre-paid return label has been sent to the email address on your account. Simply print it, attach it to your return package, and drop it with the carrier. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued.
Alright. See that it gets done quickly. Goodbye.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
